LightningComponentBundle.description: A simple utility for Base64 encoded strings to decode and download them as PDF file.

property.name: base64
property.label: Base64 Content
property.description: The content of the PDF file as Base64 encoded string, without a data URL prefix. An example file is used until this is set.

property.name: fileName
property.label: File Name
property.description: The name of the downloaded file.
